summary.text: Julie Hippler is the Democratic candidate for the Montana State Senate, District 25, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
A retired teacher from Billings, she says she will advocate for public schools, public lands and the rights in the Montana Constitution.

paragraphs.text: Julie Hippler graduated from St. Teresa High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Illinois State University in 1985 and a graduate degree from Montana State University-Billings in 1998.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she moved to Montana in 1990 and taught general K-6 education and students with disabilities in grades K-8 in Yellowstone County for over 30 years.

Hippler said her campaign messages include making pre-K to college education a priority, with more adequate funding for public schools, and addressing affordability in housing, healthcare, childcare, utilities and groceries.
